props.text: TL;DR: Quiet day for the core agent-payments/oracle/bounty niche (nothing new cleared 36h); the real signal is adjacent — a $116M Coldcard wallet hack tied to AI-assisted exploit discovery, and the largest funding round yet for securing autonomous agents.

props.title: Coldcard hardware wallet hack grows to $116M as Coinkite tells users to move funds now

props.text:
A 2021 firmware bug routed Coldcard seed generation to a predictable software RNG instead of the hardware RNG; four attack waves have now drained 1,816 BTC (~$116M) from 5,200+ addresses. Coinkite believes an attacker used AI to review the open-source firmware and spot the flaw — its own AI-assisted audit weeks earlier missed it — and is telling anyone who generated a seed on a Coldcard to migrate funds immediately.

Why it matters: it's a live case study in AI compressing the gap between vulnerability, discovery, and exploitation in security-critical code — the same dynamic that makes AI-judged verification (catching bad submissions before payout, not after a hack) valuable rather than optional.

props.title: Zenity raises $125M Series C — the largest round yet for securing autonomous AI agents

props.text:
Norwest led, with SoftBank Vision Fund 2, Qumra, Hitachi Ventures and Intel Capital joining; total funding now ~$185M. The platform monitors agents built on Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise, Gemini, Claude and AWS Bedrock/AgentCore for policy drift and unauthorized actions.

Why it matters: enterprise budget is now flowing specifically toward "did this agent actually do what it was authorized to do" — the verification problem AI-judged bounty/escrow systems already solve on-chain.

props.title: EU AI Act's Article 50 transparency rules became enforceable August 2

props.text:
Providers/deployers of chatbots, AI-generated content and public-interest deepfakes must now disclose AI involvement; violations run up to €15M or 3% of global turnover. The Commission's implementing guidelines only landed July 20 — two weeks before the deadline took effect.

Why it matters: any agent-facing product with EU users now carries real compliance exposure for undisclosed AI interaction, not just a best-practice suggestion.
